title: Toothless Toothpaste Squeezer
author: wonderpuddle
description:
Avoid becoming toothless by using this Toothless toothpaste squeezer.

Simply insert your toothpaste tube into Toothless' mouth and squeeze the toothpaste forward.

Only takes about an hour to create this 2-color print with only one color change.  Works with AMS or without (simply pause the print after layer 24 and switch from black to white filament).

Powered by MakerWorld-Image to Keychain (https://makerworld.com/makerlab/imageToKeychain)
